training_version_rule: Only V2 checkpoints may enter formal forward results. V1 failed/interrupted training is excluded; the original shared V1 input NPZ files remain the byte-verified observation source.
baseline_rule: Fit each input once with the existing seven-coefficient reference and ridge1e-8; do not duplicate fits across variants/checkpoints.
global_reference_source: outputs/reviewer-objective-controls-2026-10-15/shared/bundles/<input_id>.json; observed_features_observed_targets, positive_diffusion, passed only. Import the existing coefficients/KKT records; never refit them here. Unconstrained results are retained as static metadata only.
initial_shape: sin(2*pi*x+phase1)+.25*sin(6*pi*x+phase2), phases from PCG64(data_seed+20261015), divided by its nx64 maximum absolute value; odd modes make nx64 minimum=-maximum and mean=0. All four patterns share this shape, which is shared across methods/noise/variants/checkpoints.
spatial_operator: Periodic conservative arithmetic-face diffusion flux plus local reaction; same nx64 formulation for all models and truth. This is a temporal-resolution audit, not an independent spatial-formulation certificate.

numerical_comparison.truth: All ten case/seed combinations and all four ICs receive primary/refined integrations.
numerical_comparison.gap_rule: A claimed endpoint method gap must exceed the sum of the two endpoint temporal discrepancies; otherwise mark the comparison numerically unresolved. Passing this test does not certify the spatial continuum solution.
numerical_comparison.failure_rule: Retain primary and refined failures. Do not replace primary scores by whichever solve is closer to truth; failed comparisons are unresolved.

native_rule: Load original checkpoint weights on CPU, export exact polynomial-residual/tanh structure with NumpyMLPClosure, evaluate float64 including outside U, and verify against the same weights evaluated by float64 torch. Never use interpolated saved curves to evolve the PDE.
frozen_rule: Use the original selected expressions from the checkpoint evaluation; do not refit to float64 native outputs or select using true error.
out_of_support: Record accepted-state and RHS-trial-stage departures from U separately, continue actual native/symbolic formulas. A support departure is extrapolation, not automatically numerical failure.
accepted_audit_scope: Initial state, accepted RK nodes, and saved dense-output samples. These checks are not a continuous-time trajectory certificate. Queried positive D is not a certificate of positivity throughout U.
numerical_guards: Stop on nonfinite states/closures, nonpositive diffusion at a queried state, magnitude>10, step/evaluation failure, or a non-removable rational pole in a queried continuous-field state enclosure. A trial guard failure is reported as such and is not proof of continuum blow-up.
pole_rule: Cancel rational numerator/denominator common factors exactly over rational representations of stored binary floats; inspect real roots of the remaining denominator. A pole in a sampled field enclosure gives a conservative domain guard, not a fitted-model improvement claim.

metrics.endpoint: sqrt(dx*sum((prediction-truth)^2))/sqrt(dx*sum(truth^2)) on each identical final-time field. If truth RMS<=1e-12, use absolute RMS and label it.
metrics.space_time: sqrt(trapezoid(dx*sum((prediction-truth)^2), saved_times))/sqrt(trapezoid(dx*sum(truth^2), saved_times)) through the same horizon, using the common0.01 sampling grid including t=0. If truth RMS<=1e-12, use time/space absolute RMS and label it.
metrics.failure: An unreached horizon has null errors and explicit failure/guard status, never zero. Completed endpoint errors remain available after a later failure. Numerical completion, accepted nonnegativity, accepted support, and trial-stage support are separate.

statistics: Aggregate over the five independent data seeds within each case/setting/variant/checkpoint/method/IC/horizon. Reused baselines, ICs, checkpoints and paired seeds are not independent replicates. Report completion/validity denominators alongside successful-subset error means.
formal_launch: Build and benchmark only until root reviews this concrete protocol and commands. Pilot artifacts are classified runtime_pilot and excluded from formal inference.
